scripts.setup: uv sync --project apps/api --extra dev && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory apps/api alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:types: uv run --directory apps/api python -m app.schema && pnpm --filter @concord/web api:types
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @concord/web lint && uv run --project apps/api ruff check --config apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api benchmarks deploy
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --config apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api benchmarks deploy
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project apps/api ruff format --config apps/api/pyproject.toml --check apps/api benchmarks deploy
scripts.benchmark: uv run --project apps/api --extra dev --frozen python benchmarks/run.py --output .local/benchmark
